name: 19047 · Langhorne, PA
findings: ZIP 19047 (Langhorne) has 135 nonprofit organizations. 78 of them (58%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 65 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19047 (Langhorne) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
